units.text: Configuration operations are used to set up and control test components and their connections.
They are summarized in table 20.
In addition to the general static rules of TTCN-3 given in clause 5, the following restrictions apply:
a) These operations shall only be used in:
TTCN-3 test cases;
behaviour invoked directly or indirectly from a test case or from behaviour started on a PTC.
b) They shall not be present in:
control behaviour;
declarations inside component type definitions; or functions invoked directly or indirectly from declarations inside component type definitions.
Table 20: Overview of TTCN-3 configuration operations
Operation: Connection Operations
Operation: Connect; Explanation: Connects the port of one test component to the port of another test component; Syntax Examples: connect(ptc1:p1, ptc2:p2);
Operation: Disconnect; Explanation: Disconnects two or more connected ports; Syntax Examples: disconnect(ptc1:p1, ptc2:p2);
Operation: Map; Explanation: Maps the port of one test component to the port of the test system interface; Syntax Examples: map(ptc1:q, system:sutPort1);
Operation: Unmap; Explanation: Unmaps two or more mapped ports; Syntax Examples: unmap(ptc1:q, system:sutPort1);
Operation; Explanation; Syntax Examples

**Operation** **Explanation** **Syntax Examples** **Test Component Operations** Create Creation of a normal or alive test Non-alive test components: component, the distinction between `var PTCType c := PTCType.create;` normal and alive test components is Alive test components: made during creation `var PTCType c := PTCType.create` `alive;` (MTC behaves as a normal test component)
Start Starting test behaviour on a test `c.start(PTCBehaviour());` component, starting behaviour does not affect the status of component variables, timers or ports
Stop Stopping test behaviour on a test `c.stop;` component
Kill Causes a test component to cease to `c.kill;` exist
Alive Returns true if the test component has `if (c.alive) …` been created and is ready to execute or is already executingbehaviour; otherwise returns false
Running Returns true as long as the test `if (c.running) …` component is executing behaviour; otherwise returns false
Done Checks whether the function running `c.done;` on a test component has terminated
Killed Checks whether a component has `c.killed { … }` ceased to exist
**Test Case Operations** Stop Terminates the test case with the test `testcase.stop ( … );` verdict error
**Reference Operations** Mtc Gets the reference to the MTC `connect(mtc:p, ptc:p);` System Gets the reference to the test system `map(c:p, system:sutPort);` interface
Self Gets the reference to the test `self.stop;` component that executes this operation
